license.name: Bell Architectural Specialties
license.registry: Florida DBPR Verify a Licensee (myfloridalicense.com/portalsearches/VerifyLicensee); City of Tampa Construction Services contractor registration (Accela)
license.note: DBPR search is a token-protected POST form; automated lookup was not run (blocked for this session), so no license result. Tampa has no public contractor registration list; per tampa.gov guides, license records are handled in Accela Citizen Access (login) and by email registration. Whether Florida requires any state license for toilet partition installation is unclear (no partitions category found; repo research/state-licensing FL = unclear, low confidence). belldiv10.com shows no license number and names no base city (lists service areas across Florida); Riverview not confirmed on the home page.
